# `aitbc wallet eth-balance`

Read the sealed Sepolia ETH balance and nonce of one address. Exactly one of ``--address`` / ``--wallet`` is required; ``--wallet`` reads only the file's plaintext ``address`` field — no decryption, no password. Read-only: nothing is signed or sent.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc wallet eth-balance [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--address` | text | — | no | 0x address to read (EIP-55 or lowercase) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name or wallet file path on this host |
| `--eth-rpc-url` | text | — | no | Sepolia JSON-RPC endpoint (default: ETH_RPC_URL env/config) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc wallet eth-balance
```
